artifacts.title: Plan
artifacts.markdown:
## Problem
The board has no way to filter cards.

## Approach
- Add a filter input to the top bar.

## Implementation steps
1. Add `filter` state in `apps/web/components/board.tsx`.
2. Filter cards by title.

## Files likely touched
- `apps/web/components/board.tsx`

## Tests
- Playwright: typing filters the board.

## Risks and open questions
- None.

## Size
S

acceptanceCriteria: Typing in the filter hides cards whose title does not match
Clearing the filter shows every card again
